commands.result: Original starter also reports ok=true and no issues, despite inherited timeline values exceeding its duration.

adaptation.details: Replaced all 9 slide IDs, visible content, and spoken notes. Changed framework labels to Reader / Listen / Explore / Choose. Set duration to 6 seconds and explicitly adapted all event, poster, and preview timestamps. No empirical claims or external materials.

visual_review.result: Comparison PNG has clear text, coherent wrapping, aligned columns, and no visible clipping. New scene labels and final footer are readable in source and decoded samples. Existing shield/tools/globe icons remain fixed procedural template motifs. No native playback or presenter-notes appearance claimed.

findings.issue: Starter garden-framework changes duration to 8 seconds but inherits awards_end=8.46, poster_time=8.1, and preview_times ending at 9. Validation gives no warning. Runtime clamps preview times but does not clamp poster time; recognition/footer is not fully revealed at the actual movie end.
findings.suggested_patch: Remove starter duration override to retain 9 seconds, or explicitly retime all timestamps. Consider validating event/poster bounds.

findings.issue: Project declares Python >=3.10, but documented python3 commands ran successfully under installed Python 3.9.6 and doctor gives no minimum-version warning.
findings.suggested_patch: Clarify/test the intended minimum and align metadata and doctor.

findings.issue: Fresh compilation emits macOS 13/15 AVFoundation deprecation warnings for synchronous asset/track/image access. Verification still passes.
findings.suggested_patch: Migrate to supported async loading APIs during maintenance.

dependencies: No prior chat, original project paths, reference assets, fixture files, network, API keys, third-party Python packages, ffmpeg, or prebuilt Swift cache were needed. This tested path uses the documented macOS frameworks, Swift compiler and system Helvetica Neue fonts. Other operating systems and surface-scene Metal requirements were not tested.
